players.product: NdPr oxide and sintered NdFeB permanent magnets

quarterly_data.signal: MP Materials' 10-Q revenue by product (in thousands): NdPr oxide and metal $94,434 for the three months ended June 30, 2026 (+277%) versus $25,045, and $165,570 for the six months (+235%) versus $49,366; no rare earth concentrate revenue versus $11,877 a year earlier; magnetic precursor products $16,524 (-17%) versus $19,861, with Magnetics Segment Adjusted EBITDA of $7,532 versus $8,089. The precursor decline came primarily from the start-up of magnet production and its effect on the products' pricing mechanism; Independence began manufacturing NdFeB permanent magnets in December 2025 and the 10X Facility is under construction.
quarterly_data.figure: NdPr oxide and metal $94,434 thousand (+277%); six months $165,570 thousand (+235%); magnetic precursor products $16,524 thousand (-17%); Magnetics Segment Adjusted EBITDA $7,532 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: MP Materials' 10-Q segment capital expenditures (in thousands): Materials $85,773 and Magnetics $144,257 for the three months ended June 30, 2026 (total $230,335), and $116,319 and $190,868 for the six months (total $307,711), versus $59,473 in the first six months of 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 2026 capex Materials $85,773 thousand, Magnetics $144,257 thousand; six months $307,711 thousand (vs $59,473 thousand)

quarterly_data.signal: Customer General Motors: as of June 30, 2026 MP Materials had collected all $150.0 million of GM's prepayments for magnetic precursor products (NdPr metal), had sold $104.5 million of them to GM and remained obligated to transfer the remaining $45.5 million within one year; it still anticipates beginning sales of finished magnets to GM in 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: $104.5 million sold; $45.5 million remaining within one year; finished magnets to GM in 2026

quarterly_data.signal: Customer Apple: as of June 30, 2026 MP Materials had received cumulative prepayments of $72.0 million from Apple under the long-term magnet supply agreement (up to $200.0 million subject to milestones) and had recognized none as revenue; it now expects to begin satisfying the performance obligations no earlier than the latter half of 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: $72.0 million cumulative prepayments; revenue no earlier than the latter half of 2027

quarterly_data.signal: MP Materials' 10-Q KPIs: NdPr production 1,757 MTs for the six months ended June 30, 2026 (+51%) and NdPr sales 2,012 MTs (+122%); rare earth concentrate REO production 11,072 MTs in the quarter (-16%) versus 13,145 MTs, and 24,055 MTs for the six months (-5%). Price protection agreement income from the DoW was $17,580 thousand in the quarter and $59,853 thousand for the six months, and MP received $93.3 million from the DoW for PPA income recognized in Q4 2025 and Q1 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: NdPr production 1,757 MTs (+51%), sales 2,012 MTs (+122%) six months; REO 11,072 MTs (-16%) Q2; PPA income $17,580 thousand (Q2), $59,853 thousand (six months); $93.3 million received from the DoW
